description: This is a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveRequestServiceTest' located in the 'tests' directory, specifically testing the 'LeaveRequestService' and related functionalities of the 'orangehrmLeavePlugin' module. It contains unit tests for methods like fetching leave statuses, leave requests, workflows, and detailed leave requests, primarily using mock objects. The file is part of the testing suite for the leave service component of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveRequestServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for LeaveRequestService methods, validating functionality like fetching leave statuses, detailed leave requests, workflows, and handling various scenarios.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Tests that the LeaveRequestService returns an instance of LeaveRequestDao from its getter.

methods.name: testGetAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly fetches all leave statuses and maps them into an associative array.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Checks that the service returns the correct leave status name for a given status code and throws exceptions for invalid codes.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the status ID by name, including exception handling for unknown names.

methods.name: testGetLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple status IDs by an array of names, including error handling.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Ensures that detailed leave requests are fetched with their associated leave days, sorted and grouped correctly.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Validates that the system fetches the correct allowed workflows given an employee, leave type, and status.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflowsWithDeletedLeaveType
methods.description: Tests behavior when a leave type is marked as deleted, ensuring workflows are still correctly fetched.

methods.name: getMockWorkflowActions
methods.description: Helper function to create mock workflow actions with specified state.

methods.name: testGetDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Verifies the fetching and structuring of detailed leaves, grouping by leave request and date.
